title: One Book Before Bed
can_do: 在一本故事后关灯的约定内提出请求、选定书，并在读完后接受睡觉。

conversation_move.label: request one thing before a boundary

trigger: Mom offers one story before lights out, and Child chooses the bear book for that agreed time.
core_response: Can we read a book before bed?
stretch_response: Can we read the bear book before bed?
setting: A quiet bedtime story together; a brief time transition leads from opening the book to finishing it later.
essential_props: one bedtime book choice: a blue sleepy-bear book and a cream wide-awake-bear book

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can we read the bear book before bed?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: That's the end. Ready for lights out?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes. I liked that story. Goodnight, Mom.

replay_cards.title: One goodnight song
replay_cards.setting: Choosing tonight's activity before lights out
replay_cards.change: Mom offers one short song as tonight's bedtime activity
replay_cards.challenge: Request a named song, sing it together, and accept lights out when the song finishes

replay_cards.title: Choose tomorrow's shirt
replay_cards.change: Mom agrees there is time to choose between two shirts already on the chair
replay_cards.challenge: Ask to choose tomorrow's shirt, identify one, set it aside, then get into bed as agreed

parent_support: Offer a real, manageable story with the lights-out boundary, and honor the chosen book.
Read the whole book at a comfortable pace in real practice. The demo's brief time transition represents that reading time; ask about lights out only when the story is finished.
